div.div:
Decoding Pipeline:
1. Extract opcode [31:25]
2. Extract A [24:17]
3. Extract B [16:9]
4. Check IMM flag [8]
5. Extract C/IMM8 [7:0]
6. Sign-extend IMM8 if needed
7. Lookup opcode handle
